text.p: A diary of major political and
financial events in Bulgaria until June 26:
* All events in Sofia unless stated otherwise
* Times GMT when available
* New listings or amendments are marked "*"
TUESDAY, MAY 13
- Sofia City Court expected to rule on an insolvency suit
against private Slavyani bank filed by the central bank.
THURSDAY, MAY 15
- Court ruling expected on an insolvency case against Bank
for Agricultural Credit (BAC) postponed from April 2
TUESDAY, MAY 20
- Sofia City Court expected to rule on an insolvency suit
against state-owned Economic Bank. Ruling has been postponed
from April 30.
FRIDAY, MAY 30
- Court ruling expected on an insolvency case against
private Businessbank.
TUESDAY, JUNE 17
- Sofia City Court expected to rule on an insolvency suit
against state-owned Balkanbank.
- Dobrich regional court expected to rule on an insolvency
case against private Dobrudzha bank.
THURSDAY, JUNE 26
- Sofia City Court expected to rule on an insolvency suit
against private Elitbank postponed from April 2
-- Sofia Newsroom +3592 91188
